cfb_body_clock_east_host_west_visitor_ea.notes: CLOSE-GRADED CFB: the CFB archive carries no verified opener (docs/cfb_data.md:42), so this is graded on the median-book close-proxy spread_line. A CFB result is replication evidence about a mechanism and never by itself changes an NFL card. No NFL evaluation window and no rotation window was spent. The four cells in family cfb_body_clock_replication are CORRELATED SUBSETS of one window and are NOT independent votes: east_host_west_visitor_early is a strict subset of west_road_early (24 of its 50 flagged games), night_west_road shares the identical body-clock definition at the opposite end of the kickoff distribution, and eastbound_multizone overlaps all three through the same timezone map. Never sign-test-pool them, and never pool them with the NFL siblings (different league, different grade, different baseline). Registered effect is the PRIMARY estimator: paired candidate-minus-baseline forced-pick accuracy delta, frozen XLG-03 benchmark arm (35 columns, ridge alpha 10, market-residual target, 500-game training floor, weekly refits trained strictly before each scored week) versus the identical estimator plus exactly this one column. Scored population 8,933 games / 199 week blocks / 13 seasons, with 271 neutral-site rows carrying NaN. Replicates NFL sibling body_clock_east_host_west_visitor_early (registry effect -0.2690, 95% [-0.6232, +0.0917], P+ 0.0714). Season-blocked secondary: 95% [-0.1340, +0.1141], P+ 0.381. SECONDARY NFL-COMMENSURABLE estimator (subset-vs-complement full-slate-scaled home_cover gap, scripts/_common.summarize, 20,000 draws): +0.0017 pts, week 95% [-0.0524, +0.0551], P+ 0.5348, season P+ 0.5382, n_flag 24, subset cover 50.00% vs complement 49.37%, raw gap +0.634 pts -- the OPPOSITE side of zero from the NFL sibling, so the NFL direction did not replicate. Per-era primary magnitudes carry OPPOSITE SIGNS (2012-2019 +0.0561, P+ 0.738; 2021-2025 -0.1116, P+ 0.034), so this pooled number is an average across a sign flip and must not be read as either era's magnitude -- both era slices are recorded separately as cfb_body_clock_east_host_west_visitor_early_era_2012_2019 and _era_2021_2025. Headroom note: 24 flagged games are 0.27% of the scored slate. Instrument checks: within-week permutation null (200 draws) mean +0.021/-0.004/+0.030/+0.007 pts across the four cells, all centred within 0.03 points of zero; positive control (candidate column replaced by realised ats_margin) +48.405 accuracy points, P+ 1.000, 95% [+47.374, +49.464] on n=8,933 -- so the full 36-column ridge fit is not blind to a real effect of meaningful size. RELIABILITY FIELD carries the underlying body-clock UTC-offset trait: Pearson r 0.9858 95% [0.9843, 0.9871], Spearman-Brown 0.9928, n=2,420 team-seasons (odd/even-week split-half). The per-cell EXPOSURE propensities are, for the record: west_road_early SB 0.0990 (r 0.0521, 95% [-0.0121, +0.1966], P+ 0.6245); east_host_west_visitor_early SB -0.0075 (r -0.0037, 95% [-0.0060, -0.0019], P+ 0.0000); eastbound_multizone SB 0.5608 (r 0.3897, P+ 1.0000); night_west_road SB 0.7434 (r 0.5916, P+ 1.0000). For a per-team-season event that happens at most once, a positive in the odd half nearly always implies a zero in the even half, which forces a small negative odd/even correlation by construction, so the two thin cells' exposure figures measure RARITY, not the reliability of a trait.
